fact: SADCAS accredited the Standards Association of Zimbabwe Certification Services (ISMS-CERT 001) for information security management systems certification against ISO/IEC 27001:2022, effective 14 February 2026, original accreditation 25 November 2022.
title: Certificate of Accreditation: Standards Association of Zimbabwe - Certification Services
publisher: Southern African Development Community Accreditation Services (SADCAS)
